findings.recommendation: `order_summaries` runs on every customer page view (proposal, Domains: performance) and issues one `orders_of_customer` query plus one `lines_of_order` query per order returned — up to 101 sequential round trips per request for a customer with 100+ orders, growing with the customer's order count up to the limit and multiplied by traffic. The `Db` already offers `lines_of_orders(&[i64])` (`SELECT ... FROM order_lines WHERE order_id = ANY($1)`, api/src/db.rs:31): collect the order ids, fetch all lines in one call, group them by `order_id` in a `HashMap<i64, i64>` of totals, then build the summaries in the original order of `orders` (keeping orders with no line at 0) so ordering and results stay unchanged. Two queries per request instead of up to 101.
